eab.name: list_eab_catalog
eab.description: List all commands loaded from the catalog, including their target chip and options.

eab.name: prepare_eab_tool_call
eab.description: Validate the tool path, load a command preview, and create a confirmation request.

EAB_TOOL_PATH.description: Absolute path to the CLI executable (e.g. eab_tools.exe).

commandName.description: Command name from the catalog. Chip-prefixed names like "82x img_cvt" are accepted.

targetChip.description: Optional target chip filter, such as BT82X or Pre-BT82X.

cliArgs.description: Raw CLI arguments to pass after the command name.

chipGen.description: Chip token for the CLI: bt82x, bt81x, bt88x, ft81x or ft80x. Defaults to the command's own token.

eab.name: update_eab_tool_call
eab.description: Modify the options of a pending request (add, change, or remove) before execution. Show the updated preview to the user, then run execute_eab_tool_call with confirm=true after approval.

requestId.description: Request id returned by prepare_eab_tool_call or any typed eab_* tool.

options.description: Options to set or overwrite (snake_case keys). Pass null, "" or false to remove a key.

remove.description: Option keys to remove from the pending command.

cliArgs.description: For raw prepare requests: replace the raw CLI arguments entirely.

eab.name: execute_eab_tool_call
eab.description: Final gate: run a previously prepared command only after the user has approved the exact options. Returns awaiting_confirmation when confirm is false so the options can still be reviewed or edited.

requestId.description: Request id returned by prepare_eab_tool_call or any typed eab_* tool.

EAB_TOOL_PATH.description: Optional override path to the CLI executable.

confirm.description: Must be true to allow execution.

eab.name: ask_eab
eab.description: Primary assistant. Ask in natural language what tool or command to use for a task (convert image, build font, compress assets, program flash, disassemble, etc.). Returns matched commands with scores, required flags, examples and a suggested next step.

eab.name: eab
eab.description: MANDATORY routing assistant (alias of ask_eab). You MUST call this tool FIRST for any request that mentions "eab", "EVE", "Bridgetek", "eab_tools", "EVE Asset Builder", or involves EVE / FT8xx asset work (convert, compress, program, validate images/fonts/audio/video/animation/flash). Ask in natural language what tool or command to use; returns matched commands with scores, required flags, examples and a suggested next step.

eab.name: eab_sample
eab.description: Request the MCP client to generate a message through its LLM (sampling/createMessage). Useful to ask the model for a recommended EAB command or a conversion plan. Requires the connected client to support sampling.

query.description: The question to ask the model, e.g. "Which EAB command converts a PNG to RGB565 for BT82X?".

eab.name: list_eab_workflows
eab.description: List all built-in EAB multi-step workflows (conversion pipeline, flash programming pipeline, validation pipeline, ...) with their ordered steps and required tools.

eab.name: list_eab_skills
eab.description: List the full skill definitions (Skill Definition integration) exposed by this server, including the EAB tool routing rule, with the skills also available as eab://skills/<slug> resources.

eab.name: explain_eab_command
eab.description: Explain a single command: its description, chip generation, every option (flag, type, default, required) and an example invocation.

command.description: Command name, e.g. img_cvt, font, audio, flash_prog, bin2c.

targetChip.description: Optional chip token (bt82x / bt81x / bt88x / ft81x / ft80x) or target chip (BT82X / Pre-BT82X).

eab.name: find_relevant_eab_tool
eab.description: Given a natural-language task, recommend the most relevant command(s) with a reason and an example invocation.

task.description: Description of the asset conversion / validation task.

eab.name: suggest_eab_command
eab.description: Convert a natural-language request into a concrete command suggestion with the recommended MCP tool and the exact invocation to run.

request.description: Natural-language task, e.g. "Convert this PNG to RGB565".

targetChip.description: Optional chip preference: BT82X or Pre-BT82X.

eab.name: check_eab_installation
eab.description: Check whether EAB (eab_tools.exe) is installed on this PC, which version is present, and whether a newer build is available in the Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository. Call this first when eab_tools.exe cannot be found or the user asks about installing/updating EAB.

installDir.description: Optional install directory to inspect. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\EAB-CLI (override with EAB_CLI_INSTALL_DIR).

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit of Bridgetek/EAB-CLI to compare against. Defaults to main.

token.description: Optional GitHub token for the private Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository. Defaults to EAB_GITHUB_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, then `gh auth token`.

checkRemote.description: Set false to skip the GitHub lookup and only report the local installation.

eab.name: install_eab_cli
eab.description: Download and install (or update) EAB from the Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository (https://github.com/Bridgetek/EAB-CLI) when eab_tools.exe is missing or outdated. Without confirm=true it only returns the install plan; call it again with confirm=true after the user approves.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually download and install. Omit to get the plan only.

force.description: Reinstall even when the installed build already matches the latest commit.

installDir.description: Target install directory. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\EAB-CLI (override with EAB_CLI_INSTALL_DIR).

token.description: Optional GitHub token for the private Bridgetek/EAB-CLI repository. Defaults to EAB_GITHUB_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, then `gh auth token`.
